entities.summary: Dr. Aref Ali Nayed is a Libyan Islamic scholar, businessman and politician who served as Libyan Ambassador to the United Arab Emirates from 2011 to 2016. Nayed is the founder and director of Kalam Research & Media (KRM), based in Tripoli, Libya and Dubai. Until the outbreak of the revolution in Libya, he lectured on Islamic theology, logic, and spirituality at the restored Uthman Pasha Madrassa in Tripoli, and supervised graduate students at the Islamic Call College there.
